title: Stock trading app Ajaib raised a $270M Series C from SBI Holdings, the largest round since 2022 in Indonesia, where startups raised just ~$340M last year (Olivia Poh/Bloomberg)
summary: Olivia Poh / Bloomberg: Stock trading app Ajaib raised a $270M Series C from SBI Holdings, the largest round since 2022 in Indonesia, where startups raised just ~$340M last year — Ajaib, an Indonesian online stock trading platform, scored $270 million in the country's largest tech fundraising round since 2022 …
